Market today: The mood is shifting, with talk that the "brutal summer reset" is over and it's "time to buy again," according to Citadel. This positive sentiment, especially around the "Magnificent Seven" doing something they haven't since ChatGPT, could be a real driver for your tech and chip-heavy book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-54.14%) and SPAL (-60.95%) are your biggest concerns. Both are leveraged ETFs, meaning they decay over time and their drops are amplified, especially on margin. SMH (-14.29%) and QQQI (-4.56%) are also flagged for trimming.

Watch: Keep a close eye on your leveraged positions, SOXL and SPAL, for any further downside. Also, watch how the broader tech market reacts to the "Magnificent Seven" news.

Bottom line: With significant losses in leveraged positions and trading on margin, managing your risk and protecting capital is paramount right now.
plays: SOXL: Consider reducing this leveraged position given the "SELL" status and deep -54.14% loss. Leveraged ETFs decay and amplify losses, especially on margin.
SPAL: Review this new, leveraged position with a -60.95% loss. Its "NEW" status and volatility demand immediate attention to manage risk.
SMH/QQQI: Respect the "TRIM" status on these positions. Consider reducing exposure to free up capital or reduce overall portfolio risk.
